source: Written from the model page's README (replicate.com/google/gemini-omni-1.2-flash, 6 Nov): its API schema shows only when signed in. Replace with GET api.replicate.com/v1/models/google/gemini-omni-1.2-flash. An official model: run on /v1/models/google/gemini-omni-1.2-flash/predictions, no version.
pricing: Not public on Replicate without sign-in. Google's own: $0.07/s 720p (aistudio.google.com/docs/pricing, 6 Nov).

prompt.description: Text prompt. The duration input wins over any length written in the prompt.

duration.description: Clip length in seconds, 3 to 15, to the second.

resolution.description: 360p for fast drafts; 1080p and 4k are upscaled.

image.description: Starting image to animate; the first frame with last_frame.

last_frame.description: With image, the model fills in the motion between them (up to 10 s).

reference_images.description: Pass up to 6 reference images of a character, product or style; they keep the subject consistent, not literal frames. Can't be combined with image or last_frame.

video.description: Edit an existing video of up to 15 seconds. Can't be combined with any image input.
